name: MonarchActionEditor
title: ActionEditor
wrapsNative: VStack of MonarchCard per action, with a Picker(.menu) sectioned by group for the type, inputs from MonarchTextField, MonarchNumberInput, MonarchTagInput, MonarchFormField with Picker(.menu), Menu of Toggles with menuActionDismissBehavior(.disabled), and Toggle with .toggleStyle(.monarchCheckbox); reorder through a Menu and accessibilityActions
summary: Edits the ordered list of actions a rule runs; each action has a type and the labelled inputs that type defines, with validation and accessible reordering.
whenToUse: In routing rules, automations and macros, where the same editor serves many kinds of action defined as data (set team, set priority, add tags, send a message).
whenNotToUse: For the conditions of a rule use MonarchQueryBuilder; for a plain reorderable list use List with onMove (see reorderable-list); for a fixed form use MonarchFormField fields directly.
api: MonarchActionEditor.init(actions: Binding<[MonarchRuleAction]>, types: [MonarchActionType], isOrdered: Bool = true, maxActions: Int = 20, showsErrors: Bool = false, defaultType: String? = nil, labels: MonarchActionEditorLabels = MonarchActionEditorLabels(), makeID: @escaping @MainActor () -> String = { UUID().uuidString })
static func MonarchActionEditor.problems(of action: MonarchRuleAction, types: [MonarchActionType]) -> [MonarchActionProblem]
static func MonarchActionEditor.message(for problem: MonarchActionProblem, in type: MonarchActionType, labels: MonarchActionEditorLabels = MonarchActionEditorLabels()) -> String
enum MonarchActionProblem: Hashable, Sendable { case missing(parameter: String), outOfRange(parameter: String), invalid(message: String) }
MonarchRuleAction.init(id: String, type: String, parameters: [String: MonarchActionValue] = [:])

MonarchActionType.init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, group: String? = nil, parameters: [MonarchActionParameter] = [], defaults: [String: MonarchActionValue] = [:], isDisabled: Bool = false, disabledReason: String? = nil, validate: (@Sendable ([String: MonarchActionValue]) -> String?)? = nil)

MonarchActionParameter.init(key: String, label: String, kind: MonarchActionParameterKind, isRequired: Bool = false, description: String? = nil, prompt: String? = nil, emptyLabel: String? = nil, visibleWhen: (@Sendable ([String: MonarchActionValue]) -> Bool)? = nil)

enum MonarchActionParameterKind { case text, multilineText, number(minimum: Double?, maximum: Double?), select([MonarchComboboxOption]), multiSelect([MonarchComboboxOption]), tags(suggestions: [String]), boolean }
enum MonarchActionValue { case text(String), number(Double?), boolean(Bool), option(String?), list([String]); var isEmpty: Bool }

options.name: actions
options.description: The actions in the order they run, each an id, a type id and parameter values by key.

options.name: types
options.description: The kinds of action: a name, description, menu group, inputs, defaults, a disabled state with a reason and an optional extra check.

options.name: isOrdered
options.description: Whether actions run in order; adds a reorder menu and Move up / Move down accessibility actions.

options.name: maxActions
options.description: The most actions; the add button is replaced by a note at this count.

options.name: showsErrors
options.description: Shows "Fill in “Team”." under empty required inputs, "“Delay” is out of range." under a number outside its range, and the type's own check, for example after a save attempt.

options.name: defaultType
options.description: The type new actions start as; the first type that is not disabled when nil or unknown.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the action titles, the required and out-of-range messages, the reorder items and the move announcement.

options.name: makeID
options.description: Makes the id of a new action.

states.name: editing
states.description: Each action is a card titled "Action 1" with a reorder menu, a remove button, the type menu with the type's description, and its inputs.

states.name: conditional input
states.description: An input with visibleWhen appears only while its condition holds, such as Message after Notify is checked.

states.name: errors shown
states.description: Empty required inputs show "Fill in “Message”." with an icon; the type's own check shows under the card.

states.name: unavailable type
states.description: An action of a disabled type shows a warning banner with the reason; the type is disabled in the menu for other actions.

states.name: unknown type
states.description: A stored type no longer offered reads "escalate (not available)" in the menu and shows no inputs.

states.name: full
states.description: At maxActions, "You can add up to 20 actions." replaces Add action.

states.name: disabled
states.description: disabled(_:) on the editor disables every menu, input and button.

appearance: Each action is a MonarchCard on the surface role with its title in the default text role; inputs are Monarch fields; errors use the danger strong role with an icon; the unavailable warning is a warning MonarchBanner. All roles adapt to the dark and high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ActionEditor uses a ReorderableList with drag handles and move buttons and supports a custom render function per type. On iOS each action is a card in a stacked list for the phone; moving is a reorder Menu (Move up, Move down) and the same two accessibility actions, announced after the move, instead of drag. A custom parameter editor is not offered: compose MonarchActionEditor's model with your own view for types the input kinds cannot express. Multi-select is a Menu of Toggles that stays open while choosing; multi-line text is a vertical TextField. Focus after removing an action is left to the system. Android builds the same component with the same name.
accessibility: The list is a container named "Actions"; each card is a container named "Action 1, Set team" and its visible title has the header trait.
When ordered, each card has Move up and Move down accessibility actions, and "Moved to position 2." is announced after a move.
The reorder menu and the remove button are icon-only with spoken names ("Reorder action 1", "Remove action 1").
Every input is labelled; required inputs add "Required" to the hint and their error is spoken as a hint and announced by the field.
A multi-select menu reads the chosen labels as its value; disabled types and options are disabled menu items, not only grey.
Every control has a touch target of at least 44 points and the text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: Changing an action's type replaces its parameters with the new type's defaults.
Required inputs that are hidden by visibleWhen are not reported as missing.
Multi-select keeps the options' order and keeps stored ids that are no longer options.
A number outside the minimum and maximum is reported by MonarchNumberInput.
Actions of an unknown type are kept and can be changed to a known type or removed.
